story: On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier. A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner. Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest. Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper. At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread. Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind. Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember. In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm. Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves. She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy. At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.

shots.description: Brighton pier at windy autumn morning, pale blue sky, green iron girders and wooden deck. Maya stands near the railings, holding the string of her red diamond kite that flies high above the waves. Golden morning light glints on the sea.
shots.dialogue: On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier.

shots.description: Close on the red kite as a sudden gust slams it into the pier's metal railings. The sail tears loudly from corner to corner, white threads fraying against green iron. Maya's hands enter frame, reaching toward the damaged kite.
shots.dialogue: A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner.

shots.description: Maya runs along the shingle seafront, autumn wind whipping her raincoat. She hugs the broken red kite to her chest, tail ribbons dragging. The pier recedes behind her, morning light long and low.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest.

shots.description: Cosy kitchen, morning light through lace curtains. Grandfather sits at the wooden table, newspaper folded. He looks up over his glasses toward the doorway as Maya enters, wire-rim frames catching the light.
shots.dialogue: Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper.

shots.description: Over grandfather's shoulder: the red kite laid flat on the table. His aged hands thread a heavy white sailcloth thread through the eye of a large blunt needle. The patch area is clear, bamboo spars visible.
shots.dialogue: At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread.

shots.description: Two-shot at the table. Grandfather points with the needle at a tight sailor's seam he just stitched, explaining. Maya leans in, eyes on the stitch, raincoat still damp. Morning light warms the scene.
shots.dialogue: Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind.

shots.description: Insert shot: Maya's small fingers hold a camel-hair brush, dabbing metallic gold paint over the white patch. A tiny five-point star appears, shimmering. The red sailclinting in the morning light.
shots.dialogue: Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember.

shots.description: Afternoon light, warmer and lower. Maya and Grandfather walk side by side along the shingle beach toward the pier legs in the distance. Grandfather carries the mended kite under his arm, its tail ribbons neat. Waves lap gently.
shots.dialogue: In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm.

shots.description: Low angle behind Maya as she runs into the wind, string unspooling. The red kite climbs steeply, higher than the pier's highest ride, gold star catching sun. Waves roll white-capped below a bright autumn sky.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves.

shots.description: Two-shot on the sand. Maya extends the kite string toward Grandfather. He takes it, head thrown back, laughing with open mouth like a boy. The kite pulls taut above them, gold star winking.
shots.dialogue: She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy.

shots.description: Golden dusk, long shadows on wet sand. Maya and Grandfather walk home along the water's edge, the mended kite resting on Maya's shoulder, gold star glowing. Pier lights flicker on behind them, sea calm.
shots.dialogue: At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.
